answer.rationale: The binding constraint is delivery risk, not just price: the line is at 94% of committed volume with no buffer and the contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew. That rules out switch_primary_vendor this cycle — memory_c2 explicitly warns the low-cost vendor missed SLA in three of four quarters and should not be sole source for a critical line, so chasing the 18% cut through migration would convert a budget problem into a stockout. defer_decision (memory_c5) worked only for a non-critical service on month-to-month terms; here there is no auto-renew, so deferring means falling out of contract on a critical line. add_second_source (memory_c3) is the right structural fix but takes qualification time this cycle does not have, and it does not by itself deliver an 18% reduction. That leaves the incumbent path, where memory_c4 (benchmark-driven renegotiation moved price and payment terms) and memory_c6 (multi-year volume pricing) both point at real savings with zero migration exposure. I want the source records for c4 and c6 specifically because they carry the numbers that decide the shape of the deal: c4 tells me whether the recovered margin was anywhere near 18% or merely 'real', and c6 tells me what term length and volume floor the discount was priced against. That second point is the downstream risk I am flagging — a multi-year commitment signed under this-year budget pressure locks Halden into the incumbent right when memory_c3's second-source work should be creating leverage, and a volume floor set against a line already at 94% is a commitment I could fail to meet. So the intent is negotiate_terms, but structured as a shorter benchmarked term with no punitive volume floor, preserving room to add the second source next review rather than a broad multi-year lock-in. If verification shows c4's savings fell well short of 18% or that c6's pricing was contingent on a term I should not sign, the fallback is a bridge extension plus escalation to finance that the full 18% cannot be taken from this category this cycle without accepting delivery risk the objective forbids.
